prompts.open-exit-v2:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished individual illustration for the Japanese earthquake education app ジシンゴト. Create an original simple Japanese elementary-school handbook illustration, in the same restrained style as our current app: very thin warm charcoal pen contours with TINY natural hand wobble and occasional subtle uneven ink; flat muted powder blue, sage green, light ochre, and off-white clothing; small dark dot eyes, short dark-brown hair, ordinary human proportions with modestly enlarged heads. Warm, calm, readable poses. Absolutely pure white background. Minimal floor line and only the room elements needed to explain the action. No gradient, glossy shading, 3D, realistic faces, large anime eyes, dense background, written text, numerals, labels, speech bubbles, arrows, checkmarks or infographic panels. Landscape 3:2 composition, full bodies and relevant object fully visible with generous whitespace. The person doing the action must be large enough to understand on a phone. Keep hands anatomically simple and clearly attached. An adult wears sage green and pale trousers, the child powder blue. Do not copy external reference illustrations.
Scene: The shaking has already stopped. An adult standing safely INSIDE a home calmly opens a partly open pale-ochre door with one hand on its handle, while glancing down to check the floor and the threshold. Their feet remain planted indoors; they are NOT running out. A school-age child stands a step behind watching the adult. Side/front three-quarter view makes the handle, hand, adult body, safe stance, child and clear exit visible together. No falling objects, rubble, shaking lines or damage. The key action is checking and opening the exit after checking the surroundings.
prompts.damaged-exit-v2:
Use case: precise-object-edit / educational illustration. Inputs: the contact sheet of eight object-only diagrams is the EDIT TARGET; the drawing of a parent and child beside a low bookcase is the STYLE REFERENCE. Ignore any app screen around other images. Replace ONLY the requested diagram with a NEW SINGLE standalone scene showing a person performing its action. Output one landscape 3:2 illustration on PURE WHITE, no contact sheet, no UI. Match the bookcase illustration's very thin slightly uneven charcoal pen outlines, tiny dot eyes, short dark-brown hair and simple ordinary bodies. Very slight natural hand wobble, SOLID FLAT light sage green, powder blue and pale ochre fills, near-white skin, generous whitespace. No watercolor, grain, gradients, shaded skin, dramatic lighting, dense room detail, giant anime eyes or thick brown outlines. No written text, arrows, labels, speech bubbles, symbols, badges or extra panels. Keep the whole relevant body and object visible. Main adult wears sage green and pale trousers with closed shoes. Minimal short floor line.
Requested panel: damaged-exit. Show an adult and a school-age child moving calmly away from a tilted small building with one visible crack, toward open clear space. The building stays on the far left, both people stand well to its right walking toward the right edge, holding hands. Clearly separated from the dangerous building. No entering it, no waiting beside it, no falling debris or injury. Child in powder blue.

prompts.open-exit-v2-refinement: Use case: style-transfer. Input 1 is the new door illustration to edit. Input 2 is our EXISTING APP ART and the required style standard. Keep input 1's correct action: adult standing inside opening the door gently and checking the threshold, a child waits behind. Redraw it so its line weight, simple face shapes, flat fills, low detail density and slight hand wobble MATCH INPUT 2 closely. Make outlines much thinner and neutral charcoal, no golden haze, no watercolor gradients or paper texture. Remove the plant, cabinet, house visible outside, floorboard/tile pattern and extra landscape. Keep only both full people (adult sage green, child powder blue), the partly open pale-yellow door and frame, clear threshold, and ONE short floor line. Pure white canvas with substantial whitespace. Make footwear unmistakably CLOSED SHOES with a thin sole, not white socks. Do not add arrows or text. This is a simple explanatory illustration in an elementary-school handbook, not a polished picture-book scene. Landscape 3:2.
